entries.name: Giraffe
entries.style: chibi cube pet, deliberately blocky (Kenney Cube Pets): the pack's giraffe is a neckless head-body cube with ossicones, so its size is the cube's; stylized size: 2.4 m to the ossicone tips (a real giraffe is ~5 m tall), so it is the tallest animal in the library like the real one, standing just above the cube-pet elephant (2.0 m) and well above the horse (1.7 m) and lion (1.3 m); scaling it to its real height would make a 4.5 m-wide cube that dwarfs the elephant, and the cube itself (2.0 m to the crown) matches the elephant's; rigid parts moved by node tracks, no skin; colour map flattened to flat colours (maxColors 32 keeps the spots, eyes and nose apart; at 16 the eye whites and pupils merged into the coat)

source.author: Kenney (kenney.nl)
source.note: The plan's own source (wave-1 row 22). Same zip, pin and route as the elephant and lion: ingested through Blender with Textures/colormap.png as an extra member. The colour map flattens to 32 colours: the yellow-to-orange gradient -> coat, the browns (two side spots, ossicone knobs, snout, hooves) -> spots, inner ears and ossicone stems -> muzzle.
